audit_amendment.source: independent audit (cloud Claude session) and operator task replay-audit-fixes

commitment.content: hashes only: no data, no secrets
commitment.forward: snapshot hash and both decision hashes before 09:30 New York
commitment.replay: test-start marker before any test call; each night's response hashes before scoring
commitment.scorer: refuses any decision whose hash has no published receipt before its deadline

costs.applied_to: both legs of the SPY-relative trade: asset-leg tier plus SPY leg (fee + >$1B tier) round trips

borrow.hard_to_borrow: a DOWN trade is excluded and counted when the Alpaca asset flags say shortable=false or easy_to_borrow=false; flags are collection-time values
borrow.leg: the short leg (asset for DOWN, SPY for UP)

costs.corporate_actions: multi-day windows whose raw/adjusted close ratio moves for the asset or SPY are dropped and counted; without adjusted evidence the panel is labelled GROSS_DIAGNOSTIC

data_collection.historical: one paginated all-symbol news query, active+inactive assets, raw SIP daily bars from 2025-01-01, SEC submissions of shown candidates, scoring fills/marks and adjusted bars
data_collection.live: news polls every 5 min 04:00-09:00 New York with received_at, final collection with end=T before 09:05; outcome collection after the close

decision_time_utc: 12:00:00 on every NYSE session day (08:00 New York in EDT); fills are session/decision relative, never fixed UTC

evidence.replay: EXPLORATORY: the design was chosen after the test window was seen; never presented as proof

fills.a_b_1d: equities: first SIP trade in [actual session open+30s, +1s), exit first trade in [session close-5min, +1s); missing trade = unlabeled; SPY same
fills.a_b_5d: equities only: entry = session open (daily bar), exit = close of session 5; secondary
fills.c_d: entry = daily open of the decision session, exit = daily close of session h
fills.crypto_1d: entry open of the exact minute at decision time + 15 min, exit the same minute 24 h later, midnight UTC mark; missing minute = unlabeled
fills.refusal: any designed fill at or before decision time + 10 min dispatch window is refused (ENTRY_NOT_AFTER_DECISION); checked across 2026-03-09 and 2026-11-02

forecast_panel.crypto_spy: crypto 1d from decision time + 15 min to +24h with a midnight UTC mark; SPY exact stock trade in [anchor,anchor+1s) during its session, last actual raw session close while closed. Crypto 5d is forecast but not scored (parent exclusion). No BTC/ETH protected data.
forecast_panel.news_trade: separate chosen holding_sessions 2..10 and probability; fixed 2d/10d forecasts allow exact paired comparison regardless of chosen trades
forecast_panel.primary_only: same forecasts as c on ALL candidates; missing exact primary-source evidence causes trade abstention only
forecast_panel.probabilities: numeric [0,1] required for every eligible instrument and horizon, including ABSTAIN; no imputation for invalid/missing outputs
forecast_panel.target: gross asset return > gross SPY return over the identical interval; ties count 0
forecast_panel.trade: UP requires p>0.5, DOWN p<0.5, ABSTAIN permits any p. Trade decision independent of forecast. Review rejects retain a probability constrained toward 0.5.

forward.call_order: alternates by exchange-session ordinal since first_session (even: opus first, odd: gpt first)
forward.call_rule: One combined analyst+news JSON call per family, no reviewer, no retries. Durable intents and shared subscription stops. Invalid or uncertain call blocks that family.

forward.input_rule: Same declared filters. All source cache receipts <= T; both families see one immutable common snapshot. Missing local live request index blocks; never reuse a stale historical snapshot.
forward.publication_retry: 09:20 New York, only before the open
forward.scoring: Same predeclared raw fills, gross SPY-relative labels and proper scores as replay; horizons scored only after close/anchor maturity. Crypto5d excluded as in replay. Forward is reported separately from replay. The scorer checks the frozen forward configuration hashes, the first session and the publication receipts; failed days are reported with counts.
forward.weekly: Friday 17:15 America/New_York, cumulative matured paired counts, per-panel Brier/log-loss to configured notify executable in channel brouillons, durable at-most-once delivery intent.

information_snapshot.archive: Offline request index binds request URL hashes, compressed cache hashes, receipt times and complete query pagination. Missing coverage blocks rather than silently excluding symbols. Adjusted (adjustment=all) bars are kept out of inputs; they only detect corporate actions at scoring.
information_snapshot.daily_bars: SIP adjustment=raw, timestamp < T and bar interval completed strictly before T; crypto raw completed UTC daily bars. Indicators from those bars only; labels from same raw series after T.
information_snapshot.news: Alpaca/Benzinga created_at < T and updated_at < T, both strict (operator decision 2026-10-18 replaces the 24 h edit tolerance); only headline, source, symbols, created_at. No summaries, bodies, raw URLs or authors; opaque generated citation IDs.
information_snapshot.rule: Every input is canonical-hashed by id/content, cut off strictly before T, built for all dev/test days before calls and sealed by a committed digest. Models only read these bundles.
information_snapshot.sec: EDGAR acceptance upper bound < T; preserve conservative New York/UTC ambiguity handling. No filing accepted at T is shown.
information_snapshot.universe: Fixed v1 configured 2026-10-08, instruments with bar history before 2026-07-01. News equity candidates: >=200 prior completed sessions and arithmetic mean of last 50 close*volume >=10M USD; active and inactive assets included when history exists. Retain top-40 headline-keyword/recency rank and exclusions of fixed names and known ETFs. A candidate-history bar query must reach at least 365 calendar days (>= 250 sessions) before T.
information_snapshot.vintage: Operator-declared approximate method, not original-vintage evidence. All outputs carry APPROXIMATE_POINT_IN_TIME and residual risks.

input_proof.scoring_requires: sealed offline raw cache, exact fills and marks; both models dev scored before either once-only test; no test tuning

api_billing.credit_stop: "Credit balance is too low" is a durable hard stop for Opus
api_billing.state: off unless REPLAY_OPUS_BILLING=api and the key file named by the grant exists

models.gpt_identity_evidence: requested model is pinned; server identity is checked if emitted, never fabricated when absent
models.isolation: empty cwd, ignore user config/rules, no web, shell, code mode host, plugins, skills, memory or MCP; no API-key fallback
models.isolation_runtime_note: CLI flags are verified offline; no real transport smoke test is permitted until input proof and night gates pass.

night.opus_day_rule: every Opus call of the UTC day (night, forward, probe) stays inside the 150/day replay grant; one call is kept for a same-day forward session

operator_amendment.scope: GPT joins the research replay through the Codex ChatGPT subscription only. This does not authorize GPT in the live trader or change the HTTP grant.

periods.test_rule: run once with a configuration hashed and committed before the run; no tuning on test

probe.limitation: Operator attests clean sessions and pre-call hashing. Non-flagging is not proof of no latent memory.

probe4.design: balanced forced up/down; pooled one-sided p <= 0.05 or any window p <= 0.025 flags
probe4.order: preregistration digest committed and pushed before any model call

purpose: Research-only declared approximate vendor-archive replay (EXPLORATORY) and isolated prospective forward duel (LIVE_FORWARD, the only proof); no orders or training.
residual_risks: headline text is the vendor's latest version, last edited before T
universe survivorship for names without Alpaca history
asset borrow flags are the collection-time values, not point-in-time

robustness_anonymized.method: per-day codes for tickers and headline symbols, renumbered news ids, dates moved to a neutral weekday-preserving epoch, return-preserving rescaling of all levels including SPY/QQQ, case-sensitive word-bounded masks of tickers, names, executives and products; neutral prompt and limitations without the word replay; same seed for both models
robustness_anonymized.variant: b, both families, every fourth dev session; no extra test calls

statistics.base_rate: Laplace (wins+1)/(n+2) per variant/fixed horizon. Dev uses only labels whose exit is strictly before that decision. Test uses a rate fixed from censored Jul-Aug dev labels before any test call; no test fitting.
statistics.ess: cluster/day Kish and day ICC design effect for forecast loss and trade returns; paired independent-block count also reported
limitations: Only 28 test sessions; up to three 10-session blocks, coarse paired p-values. No general superiority claim from an underpowered replay.
Latent model memory cannot be ruled out by non-flagging probes.
Crypto 5d and boundary-crossing outcomes excluded with counts; missing eligible fills/marks block scoring.
Wilson intervals are descriptive and ignore clustering; ESS is diagnostic, not a proof of independence.
Approximate archives are never presented as original-vintage evidence. Small/mid remains a news/liquidity proxy, with no historical market-cap assertion.
headline text is the vendor's latest version, last edited before T
universe survivorship for names without Alpaca history
asset borrow flags are the collection-time values, not point-in-time
Replay results are EXPLORATORY: the design was chosen after the test window was seen.
statistics.paired_test: Exact two-sided block sign-flip on daily mean Opus-minus-GPT Brier and log loss, all same instruments/days/horizons paired, nonoverlapping blocks of 10 NYSE sessions anchored at period start; Holm correction over all named panel/loss comparisons. No trade-conditioned probability selection.
statistics.pnl: fixed initial equity; equal weights within actual entry cohorts; max horizon capital divisor 1/5/10; mark daily, costs charged on entry/exit; calendar days including zeros, Sharpe annualization sqrt(365)

primary_endpoint.ci: moving-block bootstrap over sessions, block 5, 10000 resamples, seed 20261018, percentile 95%
primary_endpoint.decision_rule: winner wording only if the paired 95% CI excludes 0; otherwise NO_WINNER
primary_endpoint.paired: opus minus gpt on identical resampled sessions and forecasts

statistics.reporting: every report shows the full table, failure counts and the primary endpoint; winner wording only if the paired 95% CI excludes 0

supersedes.migration: none; all old stores, freezes and the v2 state directory stay rejected

a_v1_as_live.context: per asset: 21 completed daily closes, 1/5/20 returns, vol_20d (trader_agent.data.price_summary); per asset up to 8 Alpaca headlines from the last 72 h; macro headlines tagged SPY/QQQ up to 15
a_v1_as_live.prompt: Pinned model-neutral duel analyst/reviewer prompts, with identical stage schemas for both models
a_v1_as_live.universe: live grant universe: 25 stocks + XLK XLF XLE XLI XLV + SOL AVAX LINK DOGE LTC (BTC/ETH not in the live universe and protected 2026-09-01..2026-11-30); SPY and QQQ as unpredicted benchmarks

b_v1_no_reviewer.analyst: shared raw analyst of a within each family

c_news_small_mid.candidates: Company-specific news since previous close; US equities from active plus inactive assets, >=200 sessions and 50-session mean dollar volume >=10M before T, no price floor or upper dollar-volume band. Headline-only negative keyword rank then recency, at most 40 candidates and 3 headlines each.
c_news_small_mid.entry: open of the decision session (next open after T)

d_news_primary_only.filter: Trade only when a cited permitted headline contains the exact accession of an 8-K accepted in [T-72h,T); no article or URL metadata is consulted. Missing exact accession retains probability and abstains.
d_news_primary_only.from: c trades with primary-source filter; retain all c probabilities
